text:
Riley (CSM): Quick sync 
Heads-up: Aurora dedicated pool go-live Thurs. Need final quota matrix, autoscale policy, loadtest windows, and a renewal touchpoint same week. T+72h health checks required.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Copy. What steady / peak should I simulate for chat endpoints?
Priya (SRE): Baseline 100 qps, steady 280 qps, peaks up to 720 qps (1-5m). Test phases: smoke 5m, ramp 20m, soak 40m.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll run a warmup T-24h to seed KV and tokenizer caches. Proposed commands below.
Priya (SRE): Alert thresholds: error_rate > 0.9% for 60s, p95 > 650ms for 2m (scale), p99 > 1100ms -> page. Fallback: route to quantized-medium model if p95 > 800ms for 60s.
Nora (Product): Product asks for a per-route cost cap toggle and a 1-question feedback card in the enablement email.
Jo (Support): I'm on-call Thurs. Share playbook (where to look + fallback steps) and CSAT link. I'll watch error rate and fallback triggers.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Load commands:

```
# smoke
./stress --target https://private.api.redwood/aurora --rps 100 --duration 5m --hdr "x-account:aurora"
# ramp/soak
./stress --target https://private.api.redwood/aurora --rps 280 --duration 40m --pattern ramp --hdr "x-account:aurora"
```

Sam (Solutions Eng): KV priming:

```
python tools/kv_seed.py --acct aurora --file aurora_prompts.json --concurrency 6
```

Riley (CSM): Action items:
1) Priya: commit autoscale policy + link runbook.
2) Sam: upload scripts + raw metrics to drive.
3) Jo: publish support playbook + wire CSAT T+48h.
4) Riley: notify renewal owner + attach enablement deck + feedback card.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for 2024-06-20T22:30Z 
Ticket CS-7202 :white_check_mark:
Priya (SRE): Autoscale draft snippet:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 430
  eval_window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 90
```

Riley (CSM): I'll high-touch for 10 days post-go-live. Ping when each item is complete. :thumbsup:
